name: Char Dham Yatra
desc: The complete Mumbai-to-Mumbai Char Dham — all four dhams with hotels, meals and darshan support.
lede: Seventeen days from Mumbai and back — Yamunotri, Gangotri, Kedarnath and Badrinath with sensible pacing, yatra registration handled, and support the whole way.
itin: Depart Mumbai by train; overnight journey.
Check-in and Ganga aarti at Har Ki Pauri.
Via Mussoorie and Kempty Falls; acclimatisation evening.
Janki Chatti trek (ponies available), darshan, back to Barkot.
Darshan on the Bhagirathi; Harsil valley stop; return Uttarkashi.
Long mountain drive via Tehri lake views.
Early start for the trek (ponies/heli optional); darshan.
Tapt Kund, darshan, Mana village — the last village of India.
Devprayag sangam en route; Laxman Jhula evening.
Haridwar → Mumbai by train; all four dhams complete.
inc: Private vehicle for the entire hill circuit
Darshan assistance at all four dhams

name: 12 Jyotirlinga Yatra
desc: All twelve jyotirlingas in one epic month — 3AC train, hotels, meals and darshan assistance throughout.
lede: The yatra of a lifetime: thirty days, Mumbai to Mumbai, covering all twelve jyotirlingas — Somnath to Rameshwaram — with travel, stays, meals and darshan support handled end to end.
itin: The western coast pair — sunrise aarti by the sea.
Sahyadri forest shrine and the source of the Godavari.
Ellora’s jyotirlinga and the ancient Nagnath temple.
Bhasma aarti at Ujjain and the Narmada island shrine.
The southern hill shrine above the Krishna gorge.
Darshan via the corridor; Ganga aarti at Dashashwamedh.
Ramanathaswamy darshan and the 22 teerthams — yatra complete.
Homeward with all twelve darshans done.

name: Ashtavinayak Yatra
desc: All eight swayambhu Ganpati temples in one smooth Mumbai-to-Mumbai circuit — special rates for 20+ groups.
lede: The classic three-day parikrama of Maharashtra’s eight self-manifested Ganpatis — Morgaon to Pali — sequenced the traditional way, with clean stays and no rushing.
itin: Mayureshwar first as tradition asks, then Siddhivinayak and Chintamani; night halt.
Mahaganpati, Vigneshwar and the Girijatmaj cave shrine; night halt.
Varadvinayak and Ballaleshwar; return to Mumbai by evening.
inc: AC vehicle for the full circuit

name: Vaidyanath Jyotirlinga Yatra
desc: Baidyanath jyotirlinga at Deoghar and Basukinath darshan — 3AC train, hotel and meals included.
lede: Five days to Jharkhand’s great jyotirlinga — the Baidyanath dham at Deoghar and Basukinath, travelling comfortably by 3AC train from Mumbai.
itin: Board the train from Mumbai; overnight journey.
Check in and Baidyanath jyotirlinga darshan.
Basukinath darshan and Deoghar local temples.

name: Tirupati – Kolhapur Yatra
desc: Balaji darshan at Tirumala and Mahalakshmi at Kolhapur in one well-sequenced circuit from Mumbai.
lede: Four days, two of India’s most loved shrines — Lord Venkateswara at Tirumala and Ambabai at Kolhapur — planned as one smooth circuit from Mumbai.
itin: Travel to Tirupati; evening in the temple town.
Tirumala darshan with queue assistance; Padmavathi temple.
Ambabai darshan at Kolhapur, then home to Mumbai.

name: Dwarka–Somnath Yatra
desc: Dwarkadhish, Bet Dwarka, Nageshwar jyotirlinga and sunset aarti at Somnath — Statue of Unity add-on available.
lede: Five days across Gujarat’s sacred coast — Krishna’s Dwarka with Bet Dwarka and Nageshwar, then the sea-facing jyotirlinga at Somnath and Bhalka Tirth.
itin: Arrive Ahmedabad/Rajkot and drive to Dwarka; evening at Gomti ghat.
Dwarkadhish temple, Nageshwar jyotirlinga and the Bet Dwarka boat visit.
Coastal drive via Porbandar; Somnath darshan and sandhya aarti.
Bhalka Tirth and Triveni Sangam, then drive back.
inc: Private vehicle for the full circuit

name: Ayodhya – Varanasi – Prayagraj
desc: Ram Mandir and Hanuman Garhi, the Sangam at Prayagraj, and Kashi Vishwanath with the grand Ganga aarti.
lede: Six days across the holiest triangle in the north — Ram Mandir and Hanuman Garhi in Ayodhya, the Sangam at Prayagraj, and Kashi Vishwanath with the great Ganga aarti.
highlights: Ganga aarti from a reserved boat
itin: Arrive and check in; Saryu ghat evening.
Ram Mandir darshan and Hanuman Garhi; Saryu aarti.
Drive to Prayagraj; evening at the ghats.
Sangam snan and Bade Hanuman ji, then on to Kashi.
Kashi Vishwanath corridor darshan; evening Ganga aarti at Dashashwamedh.
Dawn boat ride for early risers; return to Mumbai.
inc: Private vehicle for all intercity drives

name: Kashmir Paradise
desc: Shikara on Dal Lake, the Gulmarg gondola, Pahalgam’s valleys and the Meadow of Gold at Sonmarg.
lede: Seven days across the valley — shikara evenings on Dal Lake, alpine Gulmarg, Pahalgam’s film-famous valleys and a Sonmarg day trip.
itin: Airport pickup and an evening shikara ride on Dal Lake.
Gondola to Kongdoori; snow play in season, meadow walks in summer.
Via Pampore saffron fields; evening by the Lidder river.
Betaab and Aru valleys; optional pony trek to Baisaran.
The Meadow of Gold — Thajiwas glacier viewpoints.
Mughal gardens, Shankaracharya temple, old-city evening.

name: Rajasthan Royal
desc: Amber Fort, the blue city, Sam sand dunes desert camp, and Udaipur’s lakes — the full royal circuit.
lede: Eight days through pink, blue and golden Rajasthan — Jaipur’s forts, Jodhpur’s ramparts, a desert-camp night at the Sam dunes of Jaisalmer, and Udaipur to finish.
itin: Check in; evening at Nahargarh for the city-lights view.
Amber Fort early, City Palace, Jantar Mantar and the bazaars.
Drive west; sunset from the clock-tower market.
Mehrangarh Fort and the blue-city walking tour.
Into the Thar; golden fort at dusk.
Havelis and fort by day; camel ride, cultural night and desert camp.
City Palace and Lake Pichola; departure.

name: Gokarna – Murudeshwar
desc: Mahabaleshwar temple at Gokarna and the towering seaside Shiva of Murudeshwar — by 3AC train from Mumbai.
lede: Four days on the Karavali coast — the Atmalinga at Gokarna, golden beach evenings, and darshan beneath Murudeshwar’s colossal seaside Shiva.
itin: Overnight 3AC train down the Konkan coast.
Mahabaleshwar temple and Koti Teertha; beach evening.
Temple darshan, the 20-storey gopura gallery and the beach.

name: Goa Holiday
desc: Beaches, churches and sightseeing across North and South Goa — for families, friends and honeymooners.
lede: A long weekend done properly — North Goa’s beaches and forts one day, South Goa’s churches and quiet sands the next.
itin: Old Goa churches, Miramar, Colva; leisure evening.

name: Kerala — God’s Own Country
desc: Tea gardens of Munnar, Thekkady’s spice hills and the Alleppey houseboat experience.
lede: Six days from Cochin through mist-covered tea country to the slow green canals of Alleppey — ending with the classic houseboat experience.
itin: Drive up through waterfalls and rubber plantations.
Tea museum, Eravikulam National Park, Top Station viewpoint.
Spice-garden walk; optional Periyar boat ride.
To the backwaters; sunset by the canals.
Fort Kochi if time permits; fly home.

name: Andaman Holiday
desc: Cellular Jail’s light-and-sound show, Radhanagar Beach and island hopping to Neil.
lede: Six days across the Andamans — history at Cellular Jail, Asia’s best beach at Radhanagar, and the quiet reefs of Neil Island.
itin: Jail visit and the evening light-and-sound show.
Morning ferry; sunset at Radhanagar Beach.
Bharatpur, Laxmanpur and the Natural Bridge.

name: Fabulous Kutch
route: Bhuj · Dhordo · White Rann · Kalo Dungar
desc: The White Rann at sunset, Kalo Dungar’s panorama, and Bhuj’s palaces and craft villages.
lede: Three days in India’s white desert — Bhuj’s Aina Mahal and Prag Mahal, the craft villages of Banni, Kalo Dungar, and the endless White Rann glowing at sunset.
itin: Swaminarayan temple, Aina Mahal, Prag Mahal and the royal cenotaphs.
Bhirandiyara and Ludiya craft villages, Khavda, Kalo Dungar — then the White Rann for sunset.
Dhordo → Bhuj; drop at the railway station or airport.

name: Himachal — Shimla & Manali
desc: Shimla’s Mall Road, Solang Valley, the Atal Tunnel and Old Manali — the classic hill double-bill.
lede: Six days in the hills — colonial Shimla, the drive along the Beas to Manali, Solang Valley’s ropeway and through the Atal Tunnel in season.
itin: Arrive Chandigarh and drive up; evening on the Ridge and Mall Road.
Kufri, Green Valley and Jakhoo temple.
Scenic drive along the Beas; riverside check-in.
Ropeway, optional paragliding, through the tunnel to Sissu in season.
Hadimba temple, Vashisht hot springs, Old Manali cafés.

name: Thailand — Bangkok & Pattaya
desc: Coral Island speedboat day, Pattaya’s beaches, and Bangkok’s temples, markets and malls.
lede: The classic first Thailand trip — Pattaya’s Coral Island and beachfront, then Bangkok’s temples, street food and shopping.

Speedboat to Koh Larn; Pattaya sightseeing.
Sanctuary of Truth photo stop; drive to Bangkok.
City and temple tour, then shopping time.

name: Dubai
desc: Burj Khalifa, dune-bashing with BBQ dinner, and a day for Abu Dhabi or the malls.
lede: Five days of the Gulf’s greatest hits — the view from the Burj, golden-hour dune bashing, and Abu Dhabi or shopping to finish.

Dune-bashing, camel rides, BBQ dinner under the stars.
Sheikh Zayed Grand Mosque day trip or mall day.

name: Singapore
desc: Marina Bay, Sentosa Island and a Universal Studios day in Asia’s cleanest city.
lede: Five days in the Lion City — the Marina Bay skyline, a full Sentosa day, and Universal Studios or leisure to finish.

Merlion, Gardens by the Bay, Chinatown.
Cable car, beaches, Wings of Time show.

name: Malaysia
desc: Petronas Towers, Batu Caves and the Genting Highlands cable car — KL done right.
lede: Five days across Kuala Lumpur and the cool Genting Highlands — twin towers, cave temples and serious shopping.

Awana Skyway cable car; hilltop entertainment.

desc: Two countries, one trip — KL and Genting, then across to Singapore and Sentosa.

City tour and Sentosa with Wings of Time.

name: Sri Lanka
desc: Temple of the Tooth, misty tea country and Bentota’s golden beaches.
lede: Six days around Sri Lanka — Kandy’s sacred Temple of the Tooth, the tea hills of Nuwara Eliya, and beach time at Bentota.
itin: Via Pinnawala; Temple of the Tooth ritual.
Down through the hills to the coast.

name: Nepal
desc: Pashupatinath darshan, Kathmandu’s stupas and Pokhara’s lakeside — no visa for Indians.

name: Vietnam

desc: A Halong Bay cruise between limestone islands, Hanoi’s old quarter, and buzzing Ho Chi Minh City.
lede: Six days across Vietnam — Hanoi’s lakes and old quarter, a day cruising Halong Bay, then south to Ho Chi Minh City.

Full-day cruise with cave visit and lunch.
Fly south; Ben Thanh market evening.
Notre Dame, post office, war museum.

name: Bhutan
desc: Dzongs, prayer flags and mountain passes — Thimphu, Punakha and Paro in the last Himalayan kingdom.
lede: Six days in the kingdom of happiness — Thimphu’s giant Buddha, Punakha’s river-junction dzong, and Paro’s valley beneath the Tiger’s Nest.

Buddha Dordenma, Memorial Chorten, Tashichho Dzong.
Chimi Lhakhang walk, back over the pass.
Rinpung Dzong, National Museum; optional Tiger’s Nest hike.

name: Bali
desc: Ubud’s rice terraces, a Nusa Penida day trip, Kuta water sports and temple sunsets.
lede: Six days between jungle and reef — Ubud’s terraces and temples, the cliffs of Nusa Penida, and Kuta’s beach with a temple sunset to finish.
itin: Visa on arrival; transfer to the hotel.
Rice terraces, monkey forest, water temple.
Fast-boat day trip — Kelingking and snorkelling.
Beach day; optional parasailing and jet ski.
Tanah Lot / Uluwatu at golden hour.

name: Maldives
desc: Island resort, lagoon days and water activities — priced per couple.
lede: Four days of exactly nothing — an island resort with lagoon time, water activities and beach evenings, priced for two.

Free day on the island; sunset walk.

name: Europe — Paris, Switzerland & Italy
desc: Eiffel Tower, the Swiss Alps, Venice’s canals and Rome — the classic first Europe circuit.

Duomo stop, then the floating city.
St. Mark’s, gondola ride, island lanes.
Colosseum, Trevi fountain, Vatican outer visit.

Aguada, Baga and Anjuna — private sightseeing.

Betaab and Aru valleys by the Lidder.
The Meadow of Gold day trip.
Mughal gardens, saffron shopping, candlelight dinner.

Kufri and Mall Road at your pace.
Snow play, ropeway, Atal Tunnel in season.
Hadimba, Old Manali cafés, candlelight dinner.

desc: Radhanagar sunsets, a beach resort and a candlelight dinner by the sea — islands for two.

Bharatpur and the Natural Bridge; candlelight dinner.

City Palace and a private boat ride for two.
Into the Thar; golden fort evening.
Camel ride, cultural night and romantic desert-camp dinner.

Snorkelling, kayaks and beach time for two.
Free day; candlelight dinner on the beach.

desc: Private sightseeing, flower decoration, candlelight dinner — and a couple photoshoot option.
lede: Six days in Bali for two — Ubud’s terraces, the cliffs of Nusa Penida, a flower-decorated room and a candlelight dinner, with a couple photoshoot if you want the memories framed.

Kelingking and snorkelling — private day trip.
Pool day or the couple photoshoot.
Tanah Lot/Uluwatu golden hour; candlelight dinner.

desc: Burj Khalifa views, a private desert evening with BBQ dinner, and couple arrangements throughout.

Dunes at golden hour; BBQ dinner for two.
Mall day or the Grand Mosque.

lede: Five days for two — Kuala Lumpur’s towers and street food, the cable-car ride into Genting’s clouds, and a couple dinner to finish.
